items.title: Superior Lake Vistas
items.text: The Canter's height provides a magnificent clear view over the waters of Padam Talao and Rajbagh Lake, spotting basking mugger crocodiles and wading birds.

items.title: Better Last-Minute Availability
items.text: With 20 seats per vehicle, Canter permits are frequently available even when Gypsy quotas have completely sold out weeks in advance.

items.title: Keep Phones on Silent
items.text: Loud ringtones and notifications can cause animals to retreat back into dense undergrowth.

items.title: Remain Seated While Moving
items.text: Standing while the vehicle is negotiating dirt tracks is dangerous and against park rules.

items.title: Carry Jacket for Morning Drives
items.text: The open bus catches strong morning wind chill between November and February.

items.title: Camera Dust Protection
items.text: Use a dry bag or wrap your DSLR body and lenses to protect from dry forest dust.

blocks.heading: Canter Safari FAQs
blocks.intro: Common questions from first-time Canter safari travellers.

items.q: What is the difference between Canter and Gypsy?
items.a: The Canter is an elevated 20-seat open safari bus that gives a panoramic high vantage point over tall grasslands and lake beds, making it ideal for groups and budget-conscious travelers. The Gypsy is a smaller 6-seat 4x4 jeep best suited for narrow rocky trails and photography.

items.q: Do Canters go into the same tiger zones as Gypsies?
items.a: Yes! Canters are permitted in almost all designated core and buffer routes (Zones 1 through 10) on wide motorable trails. Many of Ranthambore’s famous tiger sightings occur right along the main tracks frequented by Canters.

items.q: Where do we board the Canter in Sawai Madhopur?
items.a: Depending on resort road width, Canters either provide direct pickup from main Ranthambore Road hotels or meet guests at nearby central checkposts like the Ranthambore Circle or Forest Gate chowki.

items.q: Is Canter safari safe for senior citizens and young kids?
items.a: Canters feature sturdy metal safety guardrails and wide cushioned bench seats, making them very secure for multi-generational families, elderly guests, and young children.
